title: Obituary—François Carlotti (1960–2026)
content: Marseille, France—The scientific community mourns the loss of François Carlotti, a distinguished senior scientist at CNRS and a founding pillar of the Mediterranean Institute of Oceanography (MIO), who passed away on 3 January 2026. A brilliant biological oceanographer, François dedicated his life to uncovering the mysteries of marine ecosystems, from the icy polar regions to the tropical high seas.
